## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation password validator should also enforce the twelve-character minimum: it still accepts passwords that violate the requirement described in the pull request.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — An eight-character password is still accepted through `app.invite.accepts_password`, leaving the new twelve-character requirement unenforced for invitations. While signup and reset now require twelve characters, `app/invite.py:1` still sets the minimum to eight, and `tests/test_invite.py:8` explicitly expects that behavior. Update the invitation minimum and its boundary tests to twelve. — Users can choose passwords through invitations that signup and reset reject as too short.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Signup and reset tests cover rejection at eleven characters and acceptance at twelve and thirteen.
